## Product
Remote MCP. API key auth. Prepaid packs $10/$25/$50 (1000/2500/5000¢). Lite $0.25, standard $0.60, fail=$0. Deep = preview/$0 (not live-billed). Live tools: research_brief (quick/standard), source_lookup. compare_options: do not call (preview/$0).
